goal: On Pi, a literal-user imm-run input (never extension-sourced input) mints the same entry token so Enrollment, batch start, stale batch retirement and same-Host recovery run with no authority dialog, print the same manifest, and lose authority on session exit, workspace change or pause (Spec D1-D4, D6).

acceptance.assertion: After a literal imm-run input, Pi enroll, start_unattended_batch and retire_stale_batch complete without requestAuthorityDialog and record a confirmation_ref of kind entry_token bound to the same intent hash or plan digest; a rework-exit choice still opens its dialog.

Each of these is refused with no Kernel mutation: input with source extension that names imm-run; a call with no prior entry; a call from another session; a call after session shutdown; a call from another workspace; a call after the run paused.
